title: 溢出定位
summary: 横向溢出先测越界元素。隐藏滚动条不会修好宽度、收缩和断行约束。
summaryEn: Measure escaped elements before clipping. Hiding a scrollbar does not repair width, shrink, or wrapping constraints.
asks: 是谁越过容器边界，隐藏还是修好约束？
asksEn: Which element escapes its container, and should we clip or repair its constraints?

links.when: 边界修好后再决定页面骨架
links.whenEn: choose the page skeleton after repairing boundaries

links.when: 越界约束不是基线与焦点对齐
links.whenEn: escaping constraints differ from baseline and focal alignment
